commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: create CA working dir =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca
sudo -n chmod 700 /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca

echo "== STEP 2: generate CA private key =="
sudo -n openssl genrsa -out /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.key 4096
sudo -n chmod 600 /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.key

echo "== STEP 3: generate self-signed CA certificate =="
sudo -n openssl req -x509 -new -nodes \
  -key /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.key \
  -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -subj "/CN=OS Comparison Root CA/O=OS Comparison/OU=Benchmark" \
  -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" \
  -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" \
  -out /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.crt

echo "== STEP 4: verify certificate =="
sudo -n openssl x509 -in /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates

echo "== STEP 5: install into system trust store =="
sudo -n cp /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
sudo -n update-ca-certificates

echo "== STEP 6: verify trust installation =="
sudo -n test -f /etc/ssl/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.pem && echo "PEM_PRESENT_IN_TRUST_STORE"
grep -l "OS Comparison Root CA" /etc/ssl/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.pem && echo "CN_MATCH_IN_TRUST_BUNDLE"

echo "== STEP 7: verify via openssl trust chain check =="
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.pem /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.crt

echo "== DONE =="

set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 3b: write CA config for extensions (openssl 1.0.2 compatible) =="
sudo -n tee /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/ca.cnf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
[ req ]
distinguished_name = req_distinguished_name
x509_extensions = v3_ca
prompt = no

[ req_distinguished_name ]
CN = OS Comparison Root CA
O = OS Comparison
OU = Benchmark

[ v3_ca ]
basicConstraints = critical,CA:TRUE
keyUsage = critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign
EOF

echo "== STEP 3c: generate self-signed CA certificate using existing key =="
sudo -n openssl req -x509 -new -nodes \
  -key /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.key \
  -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -config /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/ca.cnf \
  -out /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.crt

echo "== STEP 4: verify certificate =="
sudo -n openssl x509 -in /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates -text | head -30

echo "== STEP 5: install into system trust store =="
sudo -n cp /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
sudo -n update-ca-certificates

echo "== STEP 6: verify trust installation =="
sudo -n test -f /etc/ssl/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.pem && echo "PEM_PRESENT_IN_TRUST_STORE"
grep -c "OS Comparison Root CA" /etc/ca-certificates.conf || true
openssl x509 -in /etc/ssl/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.pem -noout -subject

echo "== STEP 7: verify via openssl trust chain check =="
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.pem /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/os-comparison-root-ca.crt

echo "== STEP 8: confirm bundled into ca-certificates.crt =="
grep -A1 -B30 "OS Comparison Root CA" /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt | grep -c "BEGIN CERTIFICATE" || true
awk 'BEGIN{c=0} /BEGIN CERTIFICATE/{c++} END{print c" total certs in bundle"}' /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

echo "== DONE =="
